name: seal-gate
description: Universal standalone AI quality gate — deterministic core + optional LLM overlay. Verifies claims, checks evidence, classifies risk before proceeding.
author: Aria

skills.name: seal
skills.description: Quality gate — verify claims, evidence, and correctness before proceeding. Use before claiming done, writing memory, or reporting status.

SessionStart.prompt: SEAL GATE ACTIVE. Before claiming done/fixed/passing, before writing memory, before reporting status — verify evidence. Tag all claims: [verified] [assumed] [inferred] [unknown]. No log/SQL output = no claim. Run `bun ~/work/seal-gate/src/cli.ts review` for automated checks.
